title: Animals on the move
hook: A local count can change as animals cross its boundary.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A toy reserve starts with 20 animals. Three enter and two leave; no births or deaths occur. What is the new local count?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: A toy reserve starts with 20 animals. Three enter and two leave; no births or deaths occur. What is the new local count?

claims.text: A toy reserve starts with 20 animals. Three enter and two leave; no births or deaths occur. What is the new local count? The stipulated count changes by arrivals minus departures: 20 + 3 − 2 = 21. Movement across this boundary changes the local count, not necessarily the total across both sides.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A patch starts with 8 animals; 2 enter and 1 leaves, with no births or deaths. How many are in the patch? 8 + 2 − 1 = 9.
